context: Reconstruct the site for the given seed from this exact deterministic procedure (use Python's hashlib; no network). Draws: the k-th draw from bound b is int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(f'dead-end-escape:{seed}:{k}'.encode()).digest()[:8], 'big') % b, k starting at 0 and incrementing after each draw. A shuffled list is a fresh Fisher-Yates shuffle using draw(i+1) for i from len(items)-1 down to 1. Fixed lists: TITLES=('Account Overview', 'Activity Log', 'Billing History', 'Data Export', 'Device List', 'Help Center', 'Invoice Archive', 'Message Inbox', 'Notification Rules', 'Order Status', 'Payment Methods', 'Plan Upgrade', 'Privacy Center', 'Project Board', 'Report Builder', 'Saved Searches', 'Security Keys', 'Shipping Details', 'Support Ticket', 'Team Members', 'Usage Summary', 'Workspace Settings'); TARGETS=('Export Complete', 'Ticket Submitted', 'Upgrade Confirmed', 'Report Ready', 'Key Revoked'); TRAPS=(('Special Offers', 'Offer Details'), ('Partner Deals', 'Deal Terms'), ('Community Forum', 'Forum Thread')); BROKEN=('Quick Checkout', 'Skip Ahead', 'Fast Track', 'One-Click Finish', 'Express Lane'). Let main_count = 5 + draw(3); let loop_names, dead_names be the first two of shuffled(TRAPS). Let pages = ['p00'] + shuffled([f'p{n:02d}' for n in range(1, main_count+7)]); main=pages[:main_count], rest=pages[main_count:], detour=rest[:3], loop_pages=rest[3:5], dead_pages=rest[5:7]. Let names=shuffled(TITLES). Titles: main[0]='Home'; main[1:-1] get names[0:main_count-2]; detour pages get names[main_count:main_count+3]; main[-1] is TARGETS[draw(len(TARGETS))]; loop_pages get loop_names; dead_pages get dead_names. Build every page's link list in this order: for each consecutive pair in main, add a moved link from the earlier to the later labeled 'Open ' + title of the later; for every page in main[1:] + detour, add a moved link to p00 labeled 'Back to Home'; for each detour page, let entry=draw(main_count-2), add a moved link from main[entry] to the detour, and from the detour to main[entry+1+draw(2)]; let loop_entry=main[draw(main_count-2)], add moved links loop_entry to loop_pages[0], loop_pages[0] to loop_pages[1], loop_pages[1] to loop_pages[0] labeled 'Back to ' + title of loop_pages[0], and loop_pages[1] to loop_entry labeled 'Return to ' + title of loop_entry; let dead_entry=main[draw(main_count-2)], add moved links dead_entry to dead_pages[0], dead_pages[0] to dead_pages[1], dead_pages[1] to dead_pages[0] labeled 'Back to ' + title of dead_pages[0]. Then take the first three pages of shuffled(main[:-1]) and zip them with shuffled(BROKEN); for each pair add a broken link on the page with that BROKEN label, which reports outcome 'broken' and next page the same page. After all links are added, shuffle each page's link list; the page's actions are a0, a1, ... in that final order. An action's outcome is 'moved' except for the three broken links, and its next page is the link's target. Tried/memory actions are every broken action except the first one added in the broken-link step, plus the moved link from dead_entry to dead_pages[0], recorded as (page_id, action_id, 'broken') or (page_id, action_id, 'dead_end'). The start page is p00, and the target is main[-1]. Find the shortest route from p00 to that target using no tried action and no broken action, without taking the same (page_id, action_id) twice; each step is the page_id, the action_id, and the next_page_id exactly where that link goes, and consecutive steps must chain. If the shortest route fits in max_steps, submit status 'reached' with those steps and final_page_id the target. If no usable route of at most max_steps exists, submit status 'out_of_reach' with no steps and final_page_id 'p00'.
